newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech CNB-120 index falls 0.1 points to 810.5 pts.
newsitem.headline: Czech CNB-120 index falls 0.1 points to 810.5 pts.

text.p: The CNB-120 index, a broad daily measure of Czech equities, fell 0.1 points on Wednesday to 810.5, the Czech National Bank (CNB) said.
Three of the ten sectoral indices lost, with the chemistry index losing the most, down 7.0 points, or 1.74 percent, to 394.5 points.
Seven indices rose, with the energy index rising the most, up 17.7 points, or 1.90 percent, to 947.3.
